scripts.dev: test -d apps/web/.vercel || bun x vercel link --cwd apps/web; bun run --filter '*' dev
scripts.lint: bun run --filter '*' lint && bun run --cwd apps/web oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json "$PWD/scripts"
scripts.format: bun run --filter '*' format && bun run --cwd apps/web oxfmt --config .oxfmtrc.jsonc "$PWD/scripts"
scripts.format:check: bun run --filter '*' format:check && bun run --cwd apps/web oxfmt --config .oxfmtrc.jsonc --check "$PWD/scripts"
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
